question: The Periyar River flows in which of the following Indian states?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kerala**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Periyar River is the longest river in the state of **Kerala, India**, spanning approximately 244 kilometers.
 
• The river is often referred to as the **"Lifeline of Kerala"** due to its critical role in supplying water for drinking, agriculture, and hydroelectric power generation.
 
• The Periyar originates from the **Western Ghats**, specifically at Sivagiri Hills near the Kerala-Tamil Nadu border, and flows into the Arabian Sea.
 
• It is home to major reservoirs and dams such as the **Idukki Dam**, which is one of the largest arch dams in Asia.
 
• The Periyar River is also ecologically significant, supporting diverse flora and fauna, including species found in the **Periyar Wildlife Sanctuary**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Western Ghats**:

 
 
• The Western Ghats are a mountain range that runs parallel to the western coast of India, spanning six states including Kerala.
 
• They are recognized as a UNESCO World Heritage Site for their rich biodiversity.
 
• The Periyar River originates from these Ghats, which act as a crucial water source for southern India.
 
 
 
• **Idukki Dam**:
 
 
• The Idukki Dam is built on the Periyar River and is a key hydropower project in Kerala.
 
• It was commissioned in 1976 and provides electricity to a significant portion of the state.
 
• The dam’s reservoir is also a popular tourist attraction and supports local ecosystems.
 
 
 
• **Periyar Wildlife Sanctuary**:
 
 
• Located near the Periyar River, this sanctuary is one of the most popular protected areas in southern India.
 
• It is known for its population of elephants and tigers, as well as its rich variety of bird species.
 
• The sanctuary also supports sustainable tourism through activities like bamboo rafting and nature walks.
 
 
 
• **Kerala’s Rivers**:
 
 
• Kerala has 44 rivers, with the Periyar being the largest and most significant.
 
• Rivers in Kerala are vital for agriculture, fishing, and hydroelectric power generation.
 
• Most rivers in Kerala originate from the Western Ghats and flow westward into the Arabian Sea.
